name: fatanpur-bazaar
description: Fatanpur Bazaar (फतनपुर बाज़ार) — single-store e-commerce + delivery platform: NestJS API, Next.js web, React Native app

scripts.build:api: npm run build:types && npm run build --workspace=apps/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build:types && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run build:types && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:types && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:types && npm run test --workspace=packages/shared-types && npm run test --workspace=apps/api
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:types && npm run test:unit --workspace=apps/api
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:api && npm run migrate --workspace=apps/api
scripts.db:seed: npm run build:api && npm run seed --workspace=apps/api
scripts.doctor: npm run build:api && npm run doctor --workspace=apps/api
scripts.seed:admin: npm run build:api && npm run seed:admin --workspace=apps/api --
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:types && npm run dev --workspace=apps/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:types && npm run dev --workspace=apps/web
